    Tables for the dimension induction #

    Support for the strong induction of Proposition 8.3 (main-theorems.tex: "disconnected algebras reduce to their connected factors"; Lemma 9.2: "W(Q_χ) is free by the dimension induction … applied to each connected factor"):

    • a ray table splits along a union of components into two tables with fewer rays, each with representation-finite linearization (a quotient of kT), and weight lifting holds for T when it holds for both pieces (lift2_of_split);
    • a representation-finite ray table presents its own linearization (self_rayPres), which is basic.
